title: Number of Substrings Containing All Three Characters
description: Given a string `s` consisting only of the characters `'a'`, `'b'`, and `'c'`, return the total number of contiguous substrings that contain at least one occurrence of all three characters `'a'`, `'b'`, and `'c'`.
hints: For every right endpoint i, track the most recent index where each of 'a', 'b', and 'c' appeared.
Any starting index from 0 up to min(lastA, lastB, lastC) forms a valid substring ending at i.

examples.explanation: There are 10 substrings in "abcabc" containing 'a', 'b', and 'c'.
The valid substrings of "aaacb" are "aaacb", "aacb", and "acb".
Only the full string "abc" contains all three letters.
